headline: Small and onshore-bound — fading peelers at best.
today: Just a foot of short-period S swell and the wind builds SSE onshore through the day. Light dawn breeze is your only clean window and it's tiny. Fun for a quick log session early, not much else.

daysToWatch.note: Big but sloppy. Up to 4.5ft at 5s, however it's onshore SSE most of the day. Only the evening lull (3mph) has a shot at cleaning it up if you can stand the short period.
The better call. Chest-high S at 5s on a good angle with N offshore in the morning. Get out early before afternoon onshore.
